Name: Claude Deck
Author: Brantley
Description: Live Claude usage limits, running Claude Code sessions, and quick-launch keys for Claude Desktop.

Actions.Name: Session Usage (5h)
Actions.Tooltip: Live 5-hour session limit usage for your Claude subscription. Press to refresh.

Actions.Name: Weekly Usage
Actions.Tooltip: Live weekly limit usage for your Claude subscription. Press to refresh.

Actions.Name: Active Sessions
Actions.Tooltip: Running Claude Code sessions. Press to cycle through session details.

Actions.Name: Today's Activity
Actions.Tooltip: Today's Claude Code activity: chats, messages, and tokens. Press to refresh.

Actions.Name: Launch Claude Desktop
Actions.Tooltip: Open the Claude Desktop app.

Actions.Name: Claude Quick Chat
Actions.Tooltip: Trigger Claude's quick-chat hotkey (Ctrl+Alt+Space).

Actions.Name: Open claude.ai
Actions.Tooltip: Open a new chat on claude.ai in your browser.

Actions.Name: Claude Code Terminal
Actions.Tooltip: Open a terminal running Claude Code in your GitHub folder.

Actions.Name: Model Usage (weekly)
Actions.Tooltip: Per-model weekly limit usage. Pick which model in the key settings.

Actions.Name: Needs You
Actions.Tooltip: Goes red the instant Claude Code blocks on a permission prompt or asks for input, with how long it has been waiting. Press to jump to that session's window. Requires the hooks: npm run install-hooks.

Actions.Name: Current Task
Actions.Tooltip: What Claude is working on right now, in its own words, with progress through its task list. Follows whichever session is busy. Press to re-read.

Actions.Name: Work Rhythm
Actions.Tooltip: A 24-hour dial of when you actually use Claude Code, from Claude's own stats cache. Current hour highlighted. Press to re-read.

Actions.Name: Lifetime Totals
Actions.Tooltip: Total messages, tool calls and sessions since you started, from Claude's own stats cache. Press to re-read.

Actions.Name: Burn Rate
Actions.Tooltip: Tokens per hour over the last hour, plus estimated time until the 5h session cap.

Actions.Name: Project Terminal
Actions.Tooltip: Open Claude Code in a specific project folder. Configure the folder in settings.

Actions.Name: Focus Session
Actions.Tooltip: Press to cycle through running Claude Code sessions and bring their window to the front.

Actions.Name: Quick Prompt
Actions.Tooltip: Open Claude quick chat and paste a canned prompt. Configure the prompt in settings.

Actions.Name: Activity Rain
Actions.Tooltip: Animated token rain while Claude Code is working. Drop several copies in a block (3x4 works well) and they arrange themselves into one canvas. Press to pause.

Actions.Name: Terminal Tail
Actions.Tooltip: A live CLI tail of session and token activity, with a blinking cursor. Drop several copies in a block. Press to pause.

Actions.Name: Game of Life
Actions.Tooltip: Conway's Life in Claude orange. Every request seeds a new glider. Drop several copies in a block. Press to pause.

Actions.Name: Burn History
Actions.Tooltip: Retro system-monitor graph of token burn over the last several minutes. Drop several copies in a block. Press to pause.

Actions.Name: Pipes
Actions.Tooltip: The screensaver, in blocks. Pipe count tracks how many sessions are working. Drop several copies in a block. Press to pause.

Actions.Name: Scuttle
Actions.Tooltip: A little critter walks across the keys while Claude is working, and curls up asleep when it isn't. Drop several copies in a block to give it room — it takes ladders and parachutes between rows. Press to poke it.

Actions.Name: 7-Day Chart
Actions.Tooltip: Press to turn the whole deck into a 7-day usage block chart. Stream Deck XL only.

Actions.Name: 7-Day Chart Cell
Actions.Tooltip: One key of the 7-day chart. Placed automatically by the bundled profile.

Actions.Name: Claude Custom
Actions.Tooltip: A Claude-styled key that opens anything you choose: app, URL, or folder.
